sources.title: Tuvalu Land Resources Survey - Niulakita
sources.publisher: FAO Land and Water Division; cataloged in FAO data catalog
sources.reference_date: Catalog lists data creation 1900-01-01 and publication 1991-01-01; creation date appears generic and is not treated as a survey date.
sources.license: Catalog identifies Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International.
sources.inspected: Catalog abstract lists landforms (Map 1), soils (Map 2), vegetation (Map 3) and coconuts (Map 4); metadata says data quality information unavailable. The only linked resource surfaced in the catalog page is an unrelated graphic overview; no georeferenced map download was exposed in the inspected page. The catalog API returned HTTP 403 on this retrieval.
sources.establishes: A potentially useful legacy physical land-resource survey exists for Niulakita.
sources.does_not_establish: A current coast polygon, legal administrative boundary, or available/restorable map bytes from the inspected catalog entry.
sources.follow_up: Ask FAO Land and Water Division for the four listed original map sheets or their georeferenced source and map scale; do not use the catalog's unrelated graphic overview as evidence.
